title: Optimal competitive ratio of online bin packing
formal: Determine the infimum asymptotic competitive ratio of deterministic online bin packing with irrevocable placement in unit-capacity bins.
definitions: Definitions and model details remain incomplete. Define input sizes, allowed item values and the uniform additive constant; distinguish asymptotic from absolute competitiveness.
answer_criterion: Supply a real approximation to the defined optimal constant and a Lean-checked proof of absolute error at most \(1/100\). Exact determination also qualifies; the approximation does not establish an associated exact conjecture. This is a provisional candidate, not a completed benchmark specification. Pending: Define input sizes, allowed item values and the uniform additive constant; distinguish asymptotic from absolute competitiveness.
context: The supplied catalogue associates this question with Leah Epstein. This is an editorial research connection, not a claim of authorship or a personal research agenda. The candidate retains the bibliography and dated caveats from that catalogue; these have not received a comprehensive independent literature review.
why: The constant measures the irreducible loss caused by committing to packing decisions without future items.

import_provenance.original_title: The optimal competitive ratio of online bin packing
import_provenance.original_statement: Determine the smallest asymptotic competitive ratio for deterministic online bin packing, with each arriving item irrevocably placed in a unit-capacity bin. The gap between the approximately 1.54278 lower bound and 1.57829 upper bound remains the central target of this research line.
